case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You pointed to rising alloy and bar costs, and we take that seriously. Option A is the package we can approve: it gives Blankstahl Werdenfels a longer contract term and a firm base for planning, at a price that reflects where those cost lines have gone since.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar producer prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.79; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.84; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.81; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since this goes beyond your own desk, we would be grateful if you would take Option A to the person who decides on your side. It is a longer commitment between two family-minded companies, and we would like to settle it together.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our offer is a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit.

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. We acknowledge the verified decreases in the AS-14404 and PPI-C2431 indices and have adjusted our offer accordingly, although company policy prohibits us from sharing internal cost breakdowns. Please be assured that I am fully authorized to negotiate and conclude this agreement directly on behalf of Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. To support your requested 24-month contract term and 45-day payment period, we must include the AS-14404 index clause, which allows us to offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.50. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We acknowledge your note regarding our delivery performance. However, a 24-month contract requires the AS-14404 index clause to manage material cost risks sustainably. By including this clause alongside your requested 45-day payment term, we are able to reduce our price to EUR 5.40 per unit. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our main offer stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit, alongside a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

message.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
message.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

You asked for volume and an index clause. Every option below carries a binding annual volume over a long contract term, which fills your capacity with a firm base. Because none of them has an index clause, no one has to carry cost swings for the months ahead, and you do not need a risk premium in the price.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.94; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 23,700 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives Blankstahl Werdenfels the binding volume and the long term you are looking for at a price we can sign.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. They can approve it as it stands: a binding annual volume over the full contract term, with a steady base for planning.

We would like to settle this as two family-run companies that have worked together reliably for years, and we mean it as a fair solution for both.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We appreciate your increased offer and the binding volume of 23,700 units; please provide the underlying forecast data to support this commitment. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. 

Please note that our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Regarding your Option A, we cannot offer a fixed price over 24 months, and our price for 90 days net with the mandatory AS-14404 index clause remains at EUR 5.30. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer is a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit.

This Angebot remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for setting out your final offer so clearly.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 5.30; index clause on AS-14404 (45 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08); payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 23,700 units a year over 24 months.

This gives Blankstahl Werdenfels a binding annual volume over a long term, which fills your free capacity with a firm base. It also gives both family companies the planning security we want from this partnership.

If you confirm it as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
